params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $workers=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='Runner.Worker.exe'"); Write-Output ('RUNNER_WORKER_COUNT='+$workers.Count); foreach($w in $workers){ Write-Output ('RUNNER_WORKER_PID='+$w.ProcessId+' PARENT='+$w.ParentProcessId+' CMD='+$w.CommandLine) }; if($workers.Count -ne 1){ throw ('Refusing to terminate: expected exactly one Runner.Worker.exe, found '+$workers.Count) }; Stop-Process -Id $workers[0].ProcessId -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $remaining=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='Runner.Worker.exe'"); Write-Output ('RUNNER_WORKER_REMAINING='+$remaining.Count); if($remaining.Count -ne 0){ throw 'Runner.Worker.exe remained after termination' }; Write-Output 'STALE_ACTIONS_WORKER_TERMINATED'
